notes: UH catalog program pages (publications.uh.edu) failed to fetch (empty or certificate error), so the 2025-26 UH degree map for the BS in Computer Science, cross-checked with the 2021-22 map and search snippets of the catalog checklist, was used. The map lists COSC 1336, 1437, 2436, 2425, 3320, 3340, 3360, 3380, 4351, a senior capstone sequence (4353 etc.) and advanced electives. UH policy (uh.edu/ai/resources/policy.php) prohibits AI unless an instructor authorizes it; none of the syllabi found cite it.
